Farmacias Ahumada
features a dedicated private label product line carrying its own brand name, alongside a vast selection of national and international pharmaceutical and dermocosmetic manufacturing partners. Its private label focuses on health, wellness, and preventive care categories like vitamins and nutritional supplements.
Chócale
Product Brands (Private Label & Major Categories)
Ahumada Private Label:
Vitamin C, Zinc, Cranberry extracts, Spirulina, and Fish Oil (Omega-3) supplements.
Dermocosmetics & Skincare:
La Roche-Posay, Eucerin, Vichy, ISDIN, Avène, Uriage, Cetaphil, and Ducray.
General Assortment:
Prescription pharmaceuticals, generic equivalents, nutritional needs, and personal care goods.
Diario Financiero
Manufacturer and Laboratory Partners
National & International Laboratories:
Sources products from top local Chilean and major global pharmaceutical manufacturers.
Global Health Distribution:
Historically supported by supply chains and global alignment through its former parent company,
Walgreens Boots Alliance
, and regional logistics networks.
